title: Excellent experience
text: We booked with Sun Travel for transfer from the Granada Airport and also from our hotel back to the airport.  The service was very good, and the vehicle was a very nice Mercedes.  We were a little worried because we don't speak any Spanish, but the service was excellent and our communications with the company was extremely responsive no matter how many questions I asked. When I go back to Granada with other family members, I will definitely be using Sun Travel.
